recipes.name: Pizza
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a pan, heat olive oil and sauté chopped onions, garlic, carrots, and celery until soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Pour in tomato sauce, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve the sauce over the cooked spaghetti and top with Parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
instructions: In a large pot, sauté onions, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add chicken thighs and cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in curry powder, cumin, and chili powder, then add tomatoes.
Pour in coconut milk and bring to a simmer. Cook for 30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the curry with steamed rice and garnish with fresh coriander.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir-fry
instructions: Cut vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
In a pan, heat olive oil and sauté garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the vegetables and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until tender.
Pour in soy sauce and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, cook chicken breasts until browned and cooked through, then set aside.
In the same pan, melt butter and sauté garlic until fragrant.
Add heavy cream and bring to a simmer, then stir in Parmesan cheese.
Slice the chicken and add to the sauce, then toss the cooked pasta into the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.name: Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a pan, cook ground beef with onions and garlic until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce and season with basil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
In a bowl, mix ricotta cheese, eggs, and a pinch of salt.
Layer noodles, meat sauce, ricotta mixture, and mozzarella cheese in a baking dish.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake for 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
instructions: Season fish fillets with taco seasoning and cook in a pan.
Shred cabbage and slice avocado.
Warm the tortillas in a pan.
Assemble tacos with fish, cabbage, avocado, sour cream, and a squeeze of lime.
Garnish with fresh cilantro.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Slice eggplants and dip them in beaten eggs, then coat with breadcrumbs.
Fry the eggplant slices in olive oil until golden brown.
Layer eggplant slices, tomato sauce, and cheeses in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.
Garnish with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill chicken breasts and slice them.
Toss romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Top with grilled chicken, croutons, and Parmesan cheese.

recipes.name: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté garlic.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Stir in lemon juice and parsley.
Toss the pasta in the shrimp mixture and serve.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter the bread slices.
Place cheese between the bread slices.
Grill the sandwich in a pan until golden brown and the cheese is melted.

recipes.name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients in one bowl and wet ingredients in another.
Combine both mixtures and stir until smooth.
Cook pancakes on a griddle, flipping when bubbles form.
Serve with syrup and butter.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add chopped vegetables and cook until tender.
Add herbs and simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve warm.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and season with taco seasoning.
Fill taco shells with beef, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and sour cream.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté onions, garlic, and mushrooms in olive oil and butter.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil.
Slowly add broth, stirring constantly until the rice is tender.
Finish with Parmesan cheese and serve.

recipes.name: Baked Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place salmon on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, garlic, and lemon juice.
Sprinkle with herbs and bake for 15-20 minutes.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad
instructions: Mix tuna, mayonnaise, chopped celery, and onion.
Add a squeeze of lemon and mix well.
Serve on bread or a salad.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Coat chicken breasts in breadcrumbs and fry until golden.
Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Chili
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic, then add bell peppers and cook until soft.
Add beans, tomatoes, chili powder, and cumin.
Simmer for 30 minutes, then serve.

recipes.name: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Fry pancetta in olive oil until crispy.
Toss pasta with pancetta, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Quiche
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Whisk eggs with cream and pour into pie crust.
Add bacon, cheese, and spinach, then bake for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-fry
instructions: Cook chicken until browned.
Add bell peppers, soy sauce, ginger, and garlic.
Stir-fry for 5 minutes, then serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
instructions: Slow-cook the pork shoulder until tender.
Shred the pork and mix with BBQ sauce.
Serve on buns with coleslaw.

recipes.name: Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble eggs in a pan and set aside.
Sauté carrots and peas in a pan.
Add rice and soy sauce, then mix in scrambled eggs.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices.
Cook chicken in a pan until browned.
Add tomato paste, cream, and simmer.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Clam Chowder
instructions: Sauté onions and celery in butter.
Add clams, potatoes, and cream, then simmer until potatoes are tender.

recipes.name: Pork Schnitzel
instructions: Dredge pork cutlets in flour, dip in egg, then coat with breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden brown and serve with lemon.

recipes.name: Beef Wellington
instructions: Sear beef tenderloin and coat with Dijon mustard.
Spread mushrooms over the beef and wrap in puff pastry.
Brush with egg yolk and bake.

recipes.name: Duck Breast
instructions: Score duck breasts and sear skin-side down.
Flip and cook until desired doneness.
Finish with garlic, thyme, and butter in the pan.

recipes.name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook beef and mushrooms in a pan until browned.
Add onions and beef broth, then simmer.
Stir in sour cream and serve over egg noodles.

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
instructions: Cook ziti pasta according to package instructions.
Cook ground beef with garlic and onions until browned.
Mix tomato sauce, ricotta, mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese.
Combine pasta, meat sauce, and cheese mixture, and bake for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Cook chicken breasts with fajita seasoning until browned.
Sauté peppers and onions.
Serve chicken and vegetables in tortillas with a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Falafel
instructions: Blend chickpeas with garlic, onion, and spices.
Form into balls and fry until golden brown.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic, then add tomatoes and spices.
Simmer until the sauce thickens, then crack eggs into the pan.
Cover and cook until eggs are set.

recipes.name: Chowder
instructions: Cook onions and potatoes in vegetable broth until soft.
Add cream and simmer for 10 minutes.
Top with bacon bits before serving.

recipes.name: Moussaka
instructions: Layer eggplant, meat sauce, and bechamel sauce in a baking dish.
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cook rice and ground beef.
Stuff peppers with rice, beef, and tomato sauce.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Bangers and Mash
instructions: Cook sausages in a pan until browned.
Mash potatoes and serve with sausages and gravy.

recipes.name: Cornbread
instructions: Mix all ingredients into a batter.
Pour into a greased pan and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Stuff chicken breasts with garlic butter and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden brown and serve.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Melt butter in a pan and sauté garlic.
Add cream and Parmesan, then toss pasta in the sauce.

recipes.name: Tzatziki
instructions: Grate cucumber and mix with yogurt, garlic, and dill.
Add a squeeze of lemon juice and serve.

recipes.name: Pork Carnitas
instructions: Slow cook pork with orange, cumin, and garlic.
Shred the pork and serve with cilantro.

recipes.name: Goulash
instructions: Sauté onions and beef.
Add potatoes, tomatoes, and paprika.
Simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Peking Duck
instructions: Marinate duck in soy sauce and honey.
Roast the duck and serve with pancakes and scallions.

recipes.name: Eggplant Moussaka
instructions: Layer eggplant, meat sauce, and bechamel sauce in a baking dish.
Top with cheese and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45 minutes.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella.
Arrange on a plate with basil, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta
instructions: Mix ground lamb with garlic, cumin, parsley, and coriander.
Shape into skewers and grill.

recipes.name: Beef
instructions: Mix ground lamb with garlic, cumin, parsley, and coriander.
Shape into skewers and grill.

recipes.name: Salmon Sushi
instructions: Cook sushi rice and spread on a sheet of nori.
Top with sliced salmon and roll.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.
